audience: People looking for a relaxing, low-pressure game for quiet moments: searches for relaxing, cozy or zen games, mindfulness and cozy-game audiences in Apple Ads.
story: Calm first: the mechanic in a calm hook, help that is always there, Painting, the size of the library, the daily habit, the dark finale.
promotionalText: A calm picture puzzle for quiet moments. Swap cards until the picture is whole, at your own pace: Shuffle is always free and every board waits for you.
